papers.title_en: VGA-BenchV2: An Expanded Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Evaluating Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality
papers.authors: Longteng Jiang, DanDan Zheng, Qianqian Qiao, Heng Huang, Huaye Wang, Yihang Bo, Bao Peng, Jingdong Chen, Jun Zhou, Xin Jin
papers.evidence: 统一的视频生成质量评估基准，含人工标注监督
papers.tldr: 当前视频生成的质量和美学评估面临数据规模小、人工标注稀缺等挑战。VGA-BenchV2在原有基础上大规模扩展，收集1,016个提示和60,000多个视频，新增36,000条人工标注，并且构建由VAQA-Net与两个Qwen-based LVLM评估器组成的混合评估体系，在12个主流视频生成模型上表现与人类判断高度一致。进一步，评估器作为奖励模型用于强化学习微调生成器，形成从数据构建、评估到优化的闭环，显著提升生成内容的真实感与审美偏好。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VGA-BenchV2, an extended human-aligned benchmark and optimization framework for jointly evaluating and improving video generation quality and aesthetic value. Built upon VGA-Bench, VGA-BenchV2 preserves the original fine-grained taxonomy with two primary dimensions-Aesthetic and Generation-and 52 sub-dimensions. Guided by this taxonomy, we curate 1,016 diverse prompts and collect over 60,000 videos generated by 12 mainstream video generation models. More importantly, VGA-BenchV2 substantially expands human-labeled supervision by adding 36,000 task-level annotations, including 16,200 for aesthetic quality, 13,200 for aesthetic tagging, and 6,600 for generation quality, corresponding to 13.46x, 11.15x, and 1.55x scale-ups over VGA-Bench, respectively. Leveraging this enlarged annotation corpus, we develop a hybrid evaluator architecture consisting of VAQA-Net for continuous aesthetic scoring and two Qwen-based Large Vision-Language Model evaluators, VTag-Net and VGQA-Net, for aesthetic tagging and generation quality assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong alignment with human judgments across diverse generation models. Beyond evaluation, VGA-BenchV2 further introduces an evaluation-to-optimization pipeline, where the learned aesthetic evaluator serves as a reward model for reinforcement learning-based generator fine-tuning. This closes the loop from benchmark construction and human supervision to automated evaluation and model optimization, enabling video generators to improve not only in realism but also in aesthetic quality and human preference alignment. Resources are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/BestiVictoryLab/VGA-Bench.

papers.title_en: What Do Audio-Visual Synchronization Metrics Actually Measure?
papers.evidence: 系统审计用于排序和训练音视频生成器的同步指标；直接关系到生成视频的评价指标
papers.tldr: 自动音视频同步指标被广泛用于排序和训练生成模型，但极少作为测量工具被审计。本研究联合审计AV-Align、ImageBind/JavisScore、Synchformer/DeSync等指标，在统一可靠性协议下检验畸变单调性、预处理敏感性等维度。结果显示Synchformer/DeSync是时间偏移追踪最佳指标，ImageBind/JavisScore更符合PEAVS人类代理，但指标间一致性极低（α=0.066）。因此建议采用可靠性卡片报告各指标家族分数与置信区间，而非单一同步分数。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic AV-sync metrics are widely used to rank and train audio-visual generators, but they are rarely audited as measurement instruments. We jointly audit AV-Align, ImageBind AV-relevance, JavisScore, and Synchformer/DeSync under a common reliability protocol: controlled-distortion monotonicity, preprocessing sensitivity, rank uncertainty, cross-metric agreement, PEAVS-proxy agreement, and learned fusion. The result is an axis split, not a single winner: Synchformer/DeSync is the strongest temporal-offset tracker ($τ=0.84$), ImageBind/JavisScore better match the PEAVS human-aligned proxy ($τ=0.20$) and content-disruption families, and AV-Align is the weakest standalone metric. The metrics mutually disagree (Krippendorff $α=0.066$), and neither linear nor simple $k$-NN fusion improves PEAVS agreement over the best individual metric. We recommend reporting AV-sync as a Reliability Card (metric-family breakdowns with confidence intervals) rather than a single bare synchronization score.

papers.title_en: StreamAV-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Streaming Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Kaiqi Liu, Haoxuan Zeng, Jingqi Liu, Jiacong Fang, Ziqi Cai, Yunyao Mao, Henglin Liu, Yu Sheng, Shuchen Weng, Boxin Shi
papers.evidence: 建立了面向流式音视频生成的统一评测框架，涵盖渐进式与交互式两条轨道共32个评测维度
papers.tldr: 现有视频生成基准仅评估完整序列，难以反映流式生成需求。为此，本文提出StreamAV-Bench，首个针对流式音视频生成的综合基准，建立包含渐进轨与交互轨的统一评估框架，前者考察指令遵循与长时稳定性，后者考察交互响应与状态复用，覆盖32个细粒度维度。基于13个代表性系统的评测，发现当前模型在渐进生成中存在时间漂移，在交互控制中响应滞后。通过失败分析提出改进方向，为原生联合音视频流式模型提供评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative models are pushing video generation toward unbounded streaming audio-video generation for real-time interactive worlds. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate completed sequences and struggle to capture streaming properties. To bridge this gap, we introduce StreamAV-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark tailored for streaming audio-video generation. StreamAV-Bench establishes a unified evaluation framework, including the progressive track for instruction adherence and long-horizon stability, and the interactive track for interactive response and state retention and reuse. With expert-verified evaluation cases across 32 fine-grained dimensions, we conduct an extensive evaluation of 13 representative systems. Our analysis reveals that current models suffer from temporal drift in progressive generation and responsiveness bottlenecks during interactive control. Based on a comprehensive failure analysis, we share insights to advance the development of native joint audio-video streaming models.
